intent: dark-theme variants of existing concept screenshots

outputs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application UI screenshot, dark-theme design exploration.
Primary request: convert the supplied Tangent Space screenshot to a beautifully considered DARK THEME. Edit the reference screen, preserving its layout, content, information hierarchy and density so it can be compared directly with the light version. Render a complete straight-on screenshot at the same wide desktop aspect ratio as the reference. No browser/device frame, annotations, scene, or promotional decoration.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact screen, row order, text, counts, community photographs/crops, structure, controls, spacing and recognizable Tangent Space identity. Do not invent a new layout or omit the bottom row.

Dark palette and surfaces: warm charcoal with a very subtle plum undertone. Canvas approximately #17161D; header/sidebar #1B1922; primary reading surface #201E28; fields #292632; thin separators #3B3746. Give adjacent surfaces a slight visible value difference, not heavy shadows. Off-white primary text #F0EDF5; secondary text #BCB5C9; metadata #A69EB6, readable rather than disappearing into the background. Replace the light version's intense blue links with soft muted lavender #C3AFF5. Community/Topic names should read principally as bright warm text, while actionable supporting links use restrained lavender and fine underlines. Selected navigation is a dark plum-lavender fill (#373047), with a clear soft lavender indicator. Primary filled action uses a calm rich violet around #8062CD with off-white type, not electric neon. A quiet, tactile dark interface for long reading.
Keep community photography naturally luminous: the warm conservatory, sunlit wood workbench and misty coast provide most of the color. Do not invert, grayscale, uniformly darken or recolor photographs or human portraits. The community images should feel like lit windows in a quiet dark space. Preserve subtle green/amber/blue activity dividers in a muted form where present. Maintain the hierarchy of title, author/time, excerpt and counts.
Single allowed rendering cleanup: Lumen's inconsistent generated avatars must become the SAME simple circle with a tasteful light "L" on muted plum wherever Lumen appears, alongside the existing quiet "Agent" badge. Keep other participants' photographs unchanged. Do not change any copy or count semantics.
Constraints: sharp, highly legible text at realistic app scale; every statistic and latest-contribution preview retained. No glassmorphism, gradients, glow, neon outlines, saturated blue cast, pure-black holes, glaring white borders, rainbow rows, extra chrome, decorative stars or gaming aesthetic. This must feel like the same warm, useful forum after dark, not a different product.
Specific target: the Tangent overview directory. Keep four broad summary rows: Night Garden (24 Topics /186 Posts), The Workshop (18/142), Far Horizons (12/87), and empty Common Ground (0/0). Keep Recent Topics links and separate latest contribution blocks, with all names, time stamps and excerpts. Keep exact title "Tangents", subtitle "Find a place. Join a conversation.", top All Tangents/Yours tabs and sidebar. Recent Topic links and latest Topic links are muted lavender; large community names are off-white. "Create a Tangent" stays an outlined secondary action using restrained lavender, not a luminous outline. Do not replace horizontal community summaries with a card grid.

Preserve every other pixel as closely as possible: same dark charcoal/plum theme, composition, header/sidebar, all six Topic rows, exact text, photographs, count columns, spacing and dimensions.

Replace ONLY this row's far-left circular starter photo with the same simple plum circle and light letter "L" used for Lumen's latest-contribution avatar at the right of the FIRST row. All occurrences of Lumen now share the same monogram avatar. Do not change any other participant avatar.
2. In the header's "Start a Topic" filled button, use a darker, less saturated violet fill approximately #6F50B2 and crisp off-white label/icon #F4F0F8 for stronger text contrast. Preserve its size, shape, text and position. Flat understated fill, no glow or bright gradient.
Change nothing else. Return the complete screenshot at original proportions, no annotations or framing.
